name: pam_face
detailed_description: Face recognition PAM module for biometric authentication. Uses facial recognition to authenticate users, can work with webcams or dedicated biometric readers.

parameters.fallback_auth: Fallback to password if face fails

notes:
Requires webcam or biometric camera. Fallback authentication recommended.
